scope: source-first family intake; Oak/Maple/Pine and shared Axe/Wood/Sap selected by CG-58; Mahogany/Hardwood selected by CG-63; seeds, Moss and tapping remain draft

source_facts.source: Stardew Valley video game wiki — Trees
source_facts.fact: Oak, Maple, Pine and Mahogany are common non-fruit tree species. Axe chopping leaves a stump; Oak/Maple/Pine yield Wood, while Mahogany yields Hardwood. Species have related seeds and distinct tapper outputs.

source_facts.source: Stardew Valley video game wiki — Axes and Wood
source_facts.fact: Axe is the tool for chopping trees and small stumps.

source_facts.source: Stardew Valley video game wiki — Wood
source_facts.fact: Wood is a resource obtained from trees and branches; the original game has multiple uses.

source_facts.source: Stardew Valley: The Board Game rulebook, page 11
source_facts.fact: Tree tiles become Wood when claimed; board-game movement and free pickup are not Little Valley Cards action rules.

source_facts.source: Stardew Valley Wiki — Mahogany Tree and Hardwood
source_facts.fact: Mahogany Tree grows from Mahogany Seed and Axe chopping yields Hardwood rather than Wood. The general common-tree source records Sap and a Stump; the stump yields Wood/Sap. Wild Mahogany appears on Ginger Island or under conditions in Dangerous Mines; see https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Hardwood and https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Trees.

adaptation.label: source-shaped common-tree family; CG-58/63 select V0 behavior in Forest contract
adaptation.result: Mature Tree -> Stump on the same identity; 2 Wood + 1 Sap for Oak/Maple/Pine, or 2 Hardwood + 1 Sap for Mahogany; Chop Stump 1 AP gives 1 Wood and moves tree to next-Season wait pile
adaptation.state_transition: Mature Tree -> Stump on the same tree identity
adaptation.replenishment: After Chop Stump, same tree identity returns Mature at start of next Season; undisturbed Stump does not regrow
adaptation.notes: All four common-tree variants are selected as one Mature Vegetation card each in Forest from the start. Mahogany placement in Forest is an explicit LVC paper adaptation; source locations differ. Wood/Hardwood are distinct Items. Seeds, Moss and tapping remain draft; prices and sinks are deferred.

promotion.note: Four-tree Forest packet selected: CG-58 Oak/Maple/Pine and CG-63 Mahogany. Mahogany follows same Axe/Chop/Stump/Season loop with 2 Hardwood + 1 Sap from mature tree, 1 Wood from stump; source seed/Moss/tapping remain draft.
